translationRepairs: An Chonghui, privy commissioner and grand commandant, became inspector grand master and Hedong commissioner, advanced to duke of Yi.
An Chonghui, privy commissioner and grand commandant, became inspector grand master and Hezhong commissioner, advanced to duke of Yi.
Focus 充河中節度使 names Hezhong, not Hedong, so that place-name must be corrected; the proposed 'On yichou' is not in this unit (prior 辛丑, next 己酉) and is dropped.
Congke had lost Hedong and lived in Qinghua Lane; when An Chonghui left for Hedong Mingzong summoned him weeping: "As Chonghui wished, you would never meet again!"
Congke had lost Hezhong and lived in Qinghua Lane; when An Chonghui left for Hezhong Mingzong summoned him weeping: "As Chonghui wished, you would never meet again!"
Both 自河中失守 and 出鎮河中 are Hezhong; replacing the two Hedong readings restores the circuit named in the Chinese without other changes.
On gengyin of the intercalary month An Chonghui was allowed to retire as grand tutor of the heir apparent.
On gengyin of the intercalary month Hezhong commissioner An Chonghui was allowed to retire as grand tutor of the heir apparent.
The edict identifies him as 河中節度使 before ordering retirement as 太子太師; restoring 'Hezhong commissioner' recovers that office and avoids the Hedong misreading.
That day Chonghui's sons Chongxu and others secretly fled to Hedong.
That day Chonghui's sons Chongxu and others secretly fled to Hezhong.
潛歸河中 is a secret return to Hezhong; Hedong is the wrong circuit name for 河中.
On renchen Li Congzhang of Shan moved to Hedong.
On renchen Li Congzhang of Shan moved to Hezhong.
移鎮河中 transfers Li Congzhang to Hezhong; Hedong has no support in the focus Chinese.
On jihai Murong Hua of Huaihua and Eastern Dan received the surname Li and name Zanhua and was made duke of Longxi county.
On jihai Eastern Dan Muhua, commissioner of Huaihua, received the surname Li and name Zanhua and was made duke of Longxi county.
懷化軍節度使東丹慕華 names Eastern Dan Muhua as Huaihua commissioner; 'Murong Hua' invents a Murong surname the Chinese does not use.
